rationale: The workflow is a single-job, stateful issue-maintenance workflow (actions/stale) that runs on a daily schedule and is gated to facebook/infer. It has no build steps, test steps, matrix, dependency installation, or produced artifacts, so cache, test-selection, build-selection, Bazel, and matrix patterns do not apply. P-LIT-IDLE-SCHEDULE is contraindicated because the workflow is explicitly time-based (issues age toward stale/close regardless of repository activity) and suppressing it during inactivity would break its core function. P-LIT-FAIL-SCHEDULE does not apply because recent runs are skipped, not failing, and the periodic stale check is a mandatory maintenance operation. P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE is unsafe because the job is stateful: actions/stale records handled issues in an Actions cache entry named `_state` and deletes it when the backlog is cleared; canceling a run could leave that entry locked and stall the stale-to-close progression described in the workflow comments. P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT and P-LIT-HISTORY-TIMEOUT lack representative successful-duration history since all observed runs are skipped. No evidence-supported optimization fits without risking the intended coverage or introducing unsafe behavior.
